description: Summarize a circuit. view "circuit": one line per part and per net, then locked parts, marks from the human and lock violations; filter shows one part or sub-sheet instance; detail "full" lists every prop and trace. "board": about 60 lines: size, layers, courtyard use, a line per part (position, side, [LOCKED] or "not placed"), the ten longest connections, overlaps, parts off the board, pours, silkscreen texts, drawings, unrouted count. "copper": at most 60 lines: totals, per net (tracks, vias, unrouted), pours and holes by id, violations by rule; call it before and after drawing copper. "bom": the parts grouped, and whether the board is ready to order.

filter.description: circuit only: a part or instance, e.g. J2 or PS1

name: circuit_summary
